adapter: one JSON request and response per fresh candidate child process

coverage.area: package metadata, ESM root export, and declaration
ordinary, empty, whitespace, Unicode, and literal text
SGR, CSI, OSC, C1, private, and intermediate sequences
embedded, multiline, repeated, start, and end positions

excluded_upstream_checks: type inference assertions beyond declaration entry presence
determinism: Fixed string fixtures and fresh child processes replace timing, TTY, and environment-dependent checks.
